title: Belden earns #24 spot on Fortune’s 2026 Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production list
body_markdown:
**St. Louis, Missouri – NOV 12, 2026** – Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a leading global provider of complete connection solutions, is proud to announce that it has been named to the[2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ List](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/manufacturing-production/2026) compiled by Great Place To Work® and Fortune magazine. This is Belden’s second time being named to this prestigious list, coming in at No. 24 in the Large Companies category.


Earlier this year, Belden announced its fourth consecutive year of Great Place To Work certification, expanding its certified footprint to 21 countries with the addition of Czechia and the Netherlands. Belden not only met the certification standard but also now ranks among the top large manufacturing employers evaluated through the Great Place To Work process.


“Being named one of Fortune's Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production for 2026 is a compelling validation of what our teams build every day—not just the products that connect the world, but the culture that connects our people. This recognition belongs to every Belden employee who shows up with entrepreneurial spirit, collaboration and pride in their work,” says Belden Chief Digital and Operations Officer Brad Dineley. “In an industry that's evolving as fast as ours, our culture is our competitive edge. This acknowledgement highlights the achievements of our teams across the globe."


The Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production list is based on confidential survey responses from more than 106,000 employees at Great Place To Work Certified™ companies in the industry. Through its proprietary Trust Index™ Survey, Great Place To Work evaluates employee experiences in terms of trust, fairness, well-being and professional growth, as well as how consistently those experiences are shared across demographic groups, job levels and roles.


This recognition builds on other recent workplace achievements for Belden. In September 2026, Belden received two GEN IMPACT Awards from the Global ERG Network, recognizing its company-wide employee resource group program and its Rising Professionals Network (RISE). In addition, employee participation in the company’s Be Well program, which supports physical, financial, social and emotional wellness, reached 65%. Belden also exceeded its goal of graduating more than 200 professionals from its early career leadership (LAUNCH) and internship programs.


“Congratulations to the Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production,” says Michael C. Bush, CEO of Great Place To Work. “People are at the heart of work in every industry, and manufacturing is no exception. These companies show how delivering for your people drives financial performance and turns fear of the future into the confidence to win.”


The list can be viewed on Great Place To Work’s[website](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/manufacturing-production/2026) .


#### About Belden


Belden Inc. delivers complete connection solutions that unlock untold possibilities for our customers, their customers and the world. We advance ideas and technologies that enable a safer, smarter and more prosperous future. Throughout our 120+ year history we have evolved as a company, but our purpose remains – making connections. By connecting people, information and ideas, we make it possible. We are headquartered in St. Louis and have manufacturing capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia and Africa. For more information, visit us at[www.belden.com](https://www.belden.com/) ; follow us on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/BeldenInc) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/beldeninc/) and[X/Twitter](https://twitter.com/beldeninc) .


About Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production List


Great Place To Work selected the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production by analyzing confidential survey responses from more than 1.3 million confidential employee surveys, representing the experience of more than 7.3 million workers in 2025 and 2026. Of those, more than 106,000 responses came from employees at Great Place To Work Certified companies in the manufacturing and production industries, and this ranking is based on that feedback. Companies with 10 to 999 employees competed in the small and medium category. Companies with 1,000 or more employes were considered for the large category.[Read the full methodology](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/manufacturing-production/2026) .
